project.context: A mixed residential/commercial project with existing and proposed construction areas. Master WBS applicability is not yet approved.

holds.title: Verify masonry-to-column interface
holds.reason: September field note reports a difference from the original instruction; exact geometry and disposition require site/drawing verification.
holds.action: Responsible engineer to verify observed versus intended interface and record approved disposition before affected work is accepted.

holds.title: Survey plumbing before tie-beam closure
holds.reason: September field instruction specifies pipe/sleeve checks while masonry access remains available; two exact locations and technical details are not defined.
holds.action: Plumber and responsible engineer confirm locations, pipe purpose, diameter, elevation and structural conflict checks before any penetration or closure.

holds.title: Reconcile permits and construction-phase records
holds.reason: Project index records an approval-stage label, while a later September field note describes construction; neither source proves permit clearance.
holds.action: Verify approvals, current project stage and effective permit documents with authorized project records.

holds.title: Underground-water-tank engineering/code hold
holds.reason: The project-specific underground tank package has an unresolved engineering/code audit hold and is not separately represented in the 45-task master seed.
holds.action: Resolve the independent engineering hold and approve its separate work package before any release; do not infer it is covered by foundation/waterproofing tasks.

holds.title: Approve project-specific building/WBS scope split
holds.reason: The site has existing and proposed work areas. The generic one-project WBS cannot be silently treated as an approved block-by-block schedule.
holds.action: Match each work package to the approved design revision, building/block and responsible discipline before creating a project baseline.
